what: Persisting final-bail-reason via refresh-run-logs input file assumes the file exists when refresh runs
scenario_or_breakage: `write_finalize_state` (which writes `final-bail-reason.txt`) is only invoked from `run_postmerge_phase` after merge success; the `bail` branch sets `BAIL_REASON` then `exit 3` without calling `write_finalize_state`, and `exit_stall` exits 4 without writing the file. `refresh-run-logs.sh` is only invoked from `ship-pr.sh` at pre-push checkpoints (e.g. bump/postbump ~908, CI-fix push ~1432, rebase ~1949), not on these terminal exits, so a guarded `larch-log.sh write --input-file "$IMPL_TMPDIR/final-bail-reason.txt"` usually never sees the cap-bail or stall reason the issue targets.
suggested_fix: Either drop the no-op `ship-pr.sh` constraint and write `final-bail-reason.txt` (and optionally invoke refresh) on user-bail and stall paths, or teach `refresh-run-logs.sh` to synthesize the batch from `STATE_FILE` keys (`BAIL_REASON`, `STALL_STEP`, etc.) when the file is absent, and ensure an implement-side refresh runs after `ship-pr` returns before tmpdir teardown.
